text: God is love.
This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
short: I put my trust in You.

text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
We love because He first loved us.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Trust in the LORD with all your heart.
I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good.
Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
Pray without ceasing.
Give thanks in every circumstance.
Honor your father and mother.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
Be still and know that I am God.
The earth is the LORD's, and the fullness thereof.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
The LORD is good to all.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
Love your neighbor as yourself.
A gentle answer turns away wrath.
He has made everything beautiful in its time.
You are the light of the world.
The joy of the LORD is your strength.
Taste and see that the LORD is good.
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
short: My help comes from the LORD

text: Serve the LORD with gladness.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
For God so loved the world.
Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
